in_marathi.name: Argya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Argya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Argya means 'deserving', 'worthy', or 'one who is deserving of respect'. In Hindu scriptures, Argya is often used to refer to offerings made to gods or gurus. It is a virtue to offer Argya to those who deserve it and to receive it from those who give it.
